articles.title: Word table basics: add rows, insert columns, merge cells, delete rows
articles.excerpt: Word tables have a reputation for breaking the moment you try to change them. You want one more row, you press Enter in the wrong place, and suddenly a cell is twice as tall and the layout has shifted…
articles.body: Word tables have a reputation for breaking the moment you try to change them. You want one more row, you press Enter in the wrong place, and suddenly a cell is twice as tall and the layout has shifted. Most of that goes away once you use the table commands instead of improvising with Enter and the space bar. TL;DR: Tab in the last cell adds a row; everything else lives on the Table Layout tab under Insert, Merge and Delete. We tried each step in Word for the web. Four moves Tab in the last cell adds a row. Put the cursor in the bottom-right cell and press Tab. A new empty row appears underneath, with the same column widths. This is the fastest way to extend a list. Insert rows and columns where you need them. Click a cell, go to the Table Layout tab and open Insert .

articles.title: Контакт в Telegram-боте: как не записать чужой телефон в CRM [cross-post]
articles.excerpt: Telegram Bot Contacts: Avoid Saving Someone Else's Phone in Your CRM Do not save every incoming contact.phone_number as the sender's phone number. To link a contact automatically in a private chat, co…
articles.body: Telegram Bot Contacts: Avoid Saving Someone Else's Phone in Your CRM Do not save every incoming contact.phone_number as the sender's phone number. To link a contact automatically in a private chat, compare message.contact.user_id with message.from.id . If the contact ID is missing or different, leave the number unlinked and ask the user to share their own contact using a button. This is a policy for your own Telegram Bot API handler, not instructions for configuring a 24go.site feature. It assumes that your server has already authenticated delivery and validated the update's structure. Matching IDs links the contact to the Telegram user in that event. It does not verify a phone number by SMS, establish identity, or grant permission to send marketing messages.

articles.body: Контакт в Telegram-боте: как не записать чужой телефон в CRM Не записывайте любой полученный contact.phone_number как телефон отправителя. Если идентификатор контакта отсутствует или отличается, оставьте телефон непривязанным и попросите пользователя поделиться своим контактом через кнопку. Это правило для собственного обработчика Telegram Bot API, а не инструкция по настройке функции 24go.site. Предполагается, что сервер уже проверил подлинность доставки и структуру обновления. Совпадение идентификаторов связывает контакт с Telegram-пользователем в полученном событии. Это не замена SMS-проверке, установлению личности или разрешению на маркетинговые сообщения.

The incident occurred during an Oct. 6 drop test of the full-scale Space Rider model , from the European Space Agency (ESA). articles.title: On this day in space! Oct. 22, 1992: Ashes of 'Star Trek' creator Gene Roddenberry launch into space on NASA shuttle
articles.excerpt: On Oct. 22, 1992, the space shuttle Columbia launched into space with the ashes of Gene Roddenberry, the creator of "Star Trek." Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Oct. 22, 1992, the space shuttle Columbia launched into space with the ashes of Gene Roddenberry, the creator of " Star Trek ," aboard. During mission STS-52, NASA astronaut and shuttle commander James Wetherbee brought a small container with a portion of Roddenberry's ashes into space as part of his personal effects at the request of Roddenberry's widow, Majel Barrett . It was Roddenberry's lifelong dream to go to space, but he never got to go while he was alive. But thanks to his wife, a little bit of Roddenberry finally made it to space almost exactly one year after his death. NASA and his family didn't tell anyone about it until almost two years later in 1994. Wetherbee said he was "honored to be asked" by Barrett to carry Roddenberry's ashses on the spaceflight.

articles.body: Ukraine wants its own satellite-communication system, which shouldn't be surprising given the events of the past week or so. The Ukrainian military just signed a letter of intent with two Finnish companies — the telecom giant Nokia and satellite maker ICEYE — to look into developing a sovereign satellite-communications network for Ukraine. "Ukraine needs secure, sovereign and high-performance satellite communications systems that it controls," ICEYE cofounder and CEO Rafal Modrzewski said in a statement today (Oct. 22). "We have a proven track record of delivering sovereign missions at speed to help build that capability.

articles.body: Meta has re-enabled Muse sharing after security researchers had reported that public conversation links could be easy to find. The researchers said they had been able to find Muse pages like a marketing company's internal revenue review and a small business owner's loan application. Researchers at Claroc reported earlier this week that Muse the web addresses for shared conversations from Muse were named after a conversation's title and written into public DNS. Ars Technica said Tuesday that Meta paused the sharing feature after it reached out about what was going on. articles.title: The 2027 total solar eclipse will plunge these 10 ancient Egyptian temples and monuments into darkness
articles.excerpt: The "eclipse of the century" will plunge some of ancient Egypt's most spectacular sites into darkness on Aug. 2, 2027. These temples, tombs and monuments are inside the path of totality.
articles.body: The total solar eclipse on Aug. 2, 2027, has an ancient feel. It will certainly be a celestial event for the ages — at 6 minutes 23 seconds, it will feature the longest totality on land of the 21st century and the longest anywhere until 2114. However, its point of greatest eclipse occurs just a few miles from Thebes, the magnificent religious and political capital of ancient Egypt's Middle Kingdom and New Kingdom. On the east bank of the mighty Nile is Luxor, the great city of the living, with its massive temple complexes of Karnak and Luxor. On its west bank is the city of the dead, which includes the Valley of the Kings and the Temple of Hatshepsut. Modern Luxor, population 285,000, is set to become a focal point for eclipse chasers on Aug.
